payload.description:
Looking at Now generates summaries for the issues in the current view. It does not first generate every closed descendant of an in-progress parent.

Phase 4 on Chattic.us stayed on the placeholder because JIT walked the whole initiative tree (closed epics and tasks) before the parent. Generation of the parent itself succeeds in one call.

Named recursive `kbs now <id>` still backfills children that are in that selection before the parent.

GET /api/now must ensure the default Now set (in_progress), not every issue in the store.
payload.title: Now generation must not wait on closed descendants
